description:
Read how many drafts are pending and the newest few, with lead names and hot-lead flags but no draft text. Cheaper than listing the queue.

Luca operation: GET /api/review-queue/summary
Required scopes: review_queue:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: full_content
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_review_queue_summary
title: Summarize the review queue
